resources.string: Climate and comfort through CarPlay Ultra

Debug test. Reconnect CarPlay after saving. Driver/passenger temperature, HVAC, A/C, fan, AUTO, recirculation, window defrost and comfort controls use verified OEM readback. Climate UI on iPhone is not yet confirmed.
Writes require WRITE_CANBUS. Cabin sensor, MAX A/C and radio are not advertised. Commands run only in response to an explicit iPhone request.

Debug test. Applies at the next CarPlay connection. Accepts fileTransfer offered by iPhone and only records what it sends, without processing the package or running vehicle commands. UI Sync works independently of this switch. May interrupt the CarPlay session: turn it off if CarPlay stops connecting.

Debug test. Applies at the next CarPlay connection. Offers iPhone the MFi 4.0 mutual authentication with the 3.0 identity that already signs MFiSAP; iPhone may then treat the car as a CarPlay Ultra accessory. If CarPlay stops connecting, turn it off.
